notes:
Qualification summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS (b2b). Evaluating Redwood after 6-week Hosted API POC; now moving to Dedicated procurement to meet predictable throughput and residency needs.

Timeline (recent):
- 2026-01-22: Intro call (AE Ethan) — high-level use cases, regulatory constraints (EU customer data), asked about VPC/private control plane.
- 2026-02-05: Hosted API trial started — integrations for chat support and embeddings. Basic traffic sim ran against small user cohort.
- 2026-02-18: Deep dive demo (SE Priya) — walkthrough of routing/fallback, caching, and console dashboards (Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_8472b3).
- 2026-02-25: POC results review — latency P50 ~140-160ms for chat hosted; embedding recall hit 92% on internal eval set; token cost higher than budget at scale.
- 2026-03-03: Internal architecture review — security team validated SOC2 + SSO requirement; asked for KMS/HSM integration timeline.
- 2026-03-07: Pricing kickoff with finance — requested Dedicated pricing options and sample SOW.
- 2026-03-09: Commercial sync (AE + SE + Sagehaven eng lead) — agreed on moving to a Dedicated pilot with 3-month ramp.

Workload & requirements:
- Primary: in-product conversational assistant (support-agent) + embeddings for product search and reranking on release notes and docs.
- Latency target: p50 < 200ms for chat; p95 < 500ms. Throughput target: sustained 25–40 qps during peak; occasional spikes to 120 qps (burst).
- Model preferences: open/quantized LLM (Redwood-verified variants), prefer model variants that support int8/4 quantization. Will accept smaller LLMs for routing/fallback to control cost.
- Data controls: VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS; audit logs retained 13 months; EU residency for subset of traffic.

Pricing & packaging discussion (key points):
- Sagehaven prefers committed capacity (Reserved GPU pool style) rather than pure usage billing for predictability. Proposed commit options discussed:
  * Tier A: 2x A40-equivalent reserved (baseline) — handles steady 30 qps; monthly commit X.
  * Tier B: 4x A40-equivalent reserved — better headroom for caching and KV heavy workloads; monthly commit ~2.5x Tier A.
- Burst policy: agreed need for at least 2x burst above commit for short windows (<= 10 minutes) with pre-negotiated burst pools; billing: first 10 burst minutes free per day, then overage at discounted rate.
- Overage model: prefer flat overage per GPU-hour rather than per-token for predictable finance modeling; Redwood proposed hybrid (token floor + GPU-hour for sustained overage). Sagehaven pushing back on token floor and wants clear examples.
- Ramp schedule: customer asks for 3-month ramp with step-up commit: month1 40% commit, month2 70%, month3 full commit. Also requested option to convert overage into committed credit if stable by month4.
- Pricing sensitivity: target blended unit economics ~60% of their current hosted spend at scale; finance wants clear breakpoints for break/fix and downgrade without penalties.

Security & procurement notes:
- Legal requires PoR + security appendix; security team needs HSM/KMS integration plan and SLA for audit logs delivery.
- Compliance: must show SOC2 attestation and ISO27001 roadmap. Redwood provided security FAQ (linked).

Direct quotes:
- "We need predictable monthly cost modeling; uncertainty kills our GTM plan." — Head of Finance, Sagehaven.
- "If Dedicated shows 2x cost savings at our projected scale, we'll commit to annual contract." — CTO, Sagehaven.

Next steps (short):
- AE to send draft Dedicated pricing worksheet with 3 commit tiers + explicit overage scenarios by 2026-03-12.
- SE to provide KMS/HSM integration note and timeline by 2026-03-14.
- Legal to receive initial SOW draft and PoR by 2026-03-20.
- Finance workshop to review final numbers w/ Sagehaven on 2026-03-22.

Open questions / blockers:
- Clarify how Redwood converts short bursts into billable units (token vs GPU-hour).
- Confirm ability to pin model versions across Dedicated pools during rollout.
- KMS key exchange schedule — security needs ETA from infra team.

Useful artifacts: pricing deck v2, security FAQ, Fireflies call (ff_2026-02-18_8472b3).
